permissions_group_access_description: Who belongs to the workspace and what each role can do.
permissions_group_records_description: Imported orders, stock, products, customers, and returns.
permissions_group_issues_description: Operational issues, their evidence, and the decisions they need.
permissions_group_actions_description: Changes Luma makes in connected systems.
permissions_group_workflows_description: Workflows, their drafts, versions, and triggers.
permissions_group_connections_descriptio: Connected systems, imports, and installed apps.
permissions_group_assistant_description: Ask Luma questions about workspace data.
permissions_group_activity_description: The record of what people and Luma did.
permissions_app_group_unavailable: {app} isn’t available on this Luma server, so its permissions have no effect.
permissions_workspace_settings_manage_de: Change the workspace name, display time zone and authoritative sources.
permissions_workspace_approval_policy_ma: Choose when changes need approval and whether another person must approve.
permissions_members_manage_description: Invite people, change their role, and remove their access. People can only assign roles whose permissions they hold.
permissions_roles_manage_description: Create, edit, and archive custom roles, and see their change history. People can only grant permissions they hold.
permissions_support_access_manage_descri: Allow or revoke read-only access for Luma support, and approve or decline their requests.
permissions_orders_read_description: See orders, their lines, payments, and links to the source systems.
permissions_fulfillment_read_description: See shipments, carriers, and fulfillment progress.
permissions_inventory_read_description: See stock positions, locations, and stock history.
permissions_products_read_description: See the product catalog and SKU comparisons.
permissions_customers_read_description: See customer profiles, including names, email addresses, and postal addresses.
permissions_returns_read_description: See returns, refunds, and money returned.
permissions_returns_manage_description: Open return cases, record receipt and inspection, propose resolutions, and request returns in connected systems.
permissions_insights_read_description: See operational metrics, rule charts, and import coverage.
permissions_issues_read_description: See issues, their evidence, diagnoses, and proposed changes.
permissions_issues_manage_description: Check, escalate, and resolve issues, refresh their evidence, and record what was learned.
permissions_decisions_self_assign_descri: Take unassigned decisions in Needs you and release your own.
permissions_decisions_assign_description: Assign or reassign any decision to a teammate.
permissions_decisions_respond_descriptio: Respond to approval requests. The approver must be someone other than the person who proposed the change.
permissions_actions_propose_description: Ask Luma to prepare changes in connected systems. Approval rules decide whether someone must approve them.
permissions_actions_execute_description: Apply allowed or approved changes in connected systems. Some changes need their own app permission instead.
permissions_workflows_read_description: See workflows, their versions, runs, and evidence.
permissions_workflows_author_description: Create and edit drafts, generate drafts with Luma, and test drafts.
permissions_workflows_publish_descriptio: Publish workflow versions and turn workflows on or off.
permissions_workflows_triggers_manage_de: Create, change, and pause schedules and event triggers.
permissions_playbooks_activate_label: Test and turn on issue workflows
permissions_playbooks_activate_descripti: Run Workflow tests on issues, review their results, and turn on issue workflows for selected records.
permissions_procurement_read_description: See suppliers, purchase orders, supplier commitments, and replenishment.
permissions_procurement_manage_descripti: Edit suppliers and purchase orders, review supplier commitments, and set up replenishment.
permissions_sync_manage_description: Start, pause, and fix imports, and review links between imported records.
permissions_apps_manage_description: Install, update, and uninstall apps, and grant the access they request.
permissions_assistant_use_description: Ask questions about workspace data. Answers only include data this role can see.
permissions_activity_read_restricted_des: See access changes, who made each change, and other restricted activity.
permissions_shopify_fulfillment_recovery: Preview, request approval for, and run recovery of stuck Shopify fulfillments.
permissions_shopify_inventory_correction: Preview, request approval for, and apply stock corrections at Shopify locations.
permissions_jtl_purchase_orders_submit_d: Propose, approve, and send purchase orders to JTL. Approving also needs the permission to approve changes.
permissions_jtl_orders_shipping_method_w: Propose, approve, and apply shipping method corrections to JTL orders. Approving also needs the permission to approve changes.
permissions_jtl_returns_create_descripti: Propose, approve, and create returns in JTL for return cases. Approving also needs the permission to approve changes.
permissions_role_owner_description: Full access, including granting and removing ownership. Every workspace keeps at least one owner.
permissions_role_admin_description: Runs the workspace: settings, team, connections, workflows, and every change. Can’t change owners.
permissions_role_member_description: Sees operations, records, and workflows, takes decisions, and asks Luma. Can’t change data or settings.
permissions_sales_manage_description: Accept storefront orders and read and edit Luma order records, including addresses.
permissions_group_messaging_description: Message threads from connected mailboxes, their documents, and replies.
permissions_messages_read_description: Read message threads from connected mailboxes, their attachments, and the records they are linked to.
permissions_messages_manage_description: Assign threads, write internal notes, set reply deadlines, link records, review document facts, and choose which messages Luma reads.
permissions_messages_send_description: Draft replies and send them, or request approval when they make commitments.
permissions_gmail_messages_send_descript: Send replies from connected Gmail mailboxes, and approve replies others want to send.
